title: RoleHead
description: The unique primary pointer of a role: exactly one exists per (workspace_id, role_id). Request branches never replace the primary pointer. Handoff activation swaps this pointer atomically with a compare-and-swap on generation.

role_id.description: Role id as defined by its role pack; the core has no business role enumeration.

generation.description: Increments by exactly one on each handoff activation. First primary instance is generation 1.

knowledge_revision.description: Role-wide knowledge version. Increases whenever the role publishes a document revision or a handoff summary, so handoff preparation can detect knowledge drift.

current_instance_id.description: AgentInstance currently holding the primary pointer. Older instances lose formal publish rights.

roleContract.description: Frozen identity of the installed role pack version this role is registered from. Updating the pack takes effect only through explicit upgrade and handoff, never silently for running sessions.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the role pack content this contract was installed from.
